source: Independent source-informed implementation. Upstream runtime was inspected for contracts, but is not shipped. Retained tests and the upstream MIT license preserve attribution.

implementation.targetScope: React/Preact-aware deep equality; props/options comparisons in react-popper 2.3.0.

changes: DataView compares visible bytes and offsets instead of looping indefinitely. ArrayBuffer contents participate in equality.

A bounded recursive path switches to explicit graph traversal for deep/cyclic values; structurally equal cycles compare true without console warnings. Shared identity is immaterial outside Map/Set keys.
Application exceptions propagate; matching stack/recursion text is not treated as an overflow.
Array kinds must agree, including objects that spoof an array constructor.

verification.upstream: 117 original tests pass upstream; VPM passes the same 116 functional tests on Node24/Bun. The one original cycle-warning assertion is explicitly excluded because cycle handling changed.
verification.caller: Actual react-popper2.3.0 usePopper on React19.1 with both comparators: nested equal options retain identity, changed options update once, unmount disposes once.
verification.regressions: Six focused groups and3000 generated comparisons on Node24/Bun; original DataView hang checked in a bounded subprocess.
verification.archives: Packed npm/Bun CJS/ESM, browser build and TypeScript7 consumers.
